svg.title: Optional chloroform separation aid · conceptual
svg.desc: The authors found that adding a few milliliters of chloroform improved separation. A numeric amount and exact placement within the repeated extraction sequence are not given; this source-described aid is represented as optional, not a mandatory precisely timed transfer. Conceptual action diagram. Vessel type, shape, volume, fill and physical continuity are not specified for this step. Arrows indicate an action only. No missing reactor value, phase handling or rate is inferred from this drawing.
svg.text: Vessel and physical continuity not reported
Conceptual action diagram; not measured apparatus
